SMTO-OUT-0004 — SMTO couldn't show this result because of a display fault

GUID: b9b9fc2f-c06e-44d6-b22a-af62c2f0f86d
Slug: display-primitive-invalid
Domain: OUT · Subsystem: out

What happened

  • SMTO's built-in list of ways to show results has a missing or repeated entry, so it couldn't show this result. The step's saved result isn't affected.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the step in the activity under the reply to read its saved result. A display fault does not establish that the step failed; its result is saved separately and is still there.
  2. Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. This is a fault in SMTO itself, and the details name the display entry that's missing or repeated.
  3. After the person who manages SMTO has fixed or updated it, reload the conversation. Once the display list is corrected, saved results show normally without running anything again.

What success looks like

  • After the fix, the result shows normally in the conversation.

If it still fails

  • Don't run the step again or change settings to work around it; the problem is in SMTO's display code, not in your Task.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • DisplayPrimitiveRegistry rejected a registration with a duplicate primitive_id, or was asked for a primitive_id that is not registered.

What this means

  • Display primitive registration repeats an existing primitive_id, or lookup asks for an unregistered primitive. Output extraction, rendering and summaries do not own execution truth. Their failure cannot turn a completed operation into unexecuted work or justify replay; retained exact receipts remain authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • Display primitive registration repeats an existing primitive_id, or lookup asks for an unregistered primitive.

How to diagnose it

  • Distinguish registry construction from lookup failure and retain the raw execution result.

How to fix it

  • Check build_default_display_primitive_registry and any custom primitive manifests in output_pipeline/display_primitives.py for the named duplicate or unregistered primitive_id, and correct the registry or the display plan's primitive_id. Inspect the raw receipt; completed work does not need replay to fix a display registry.
  • Inspect the raw authoritative receipt and report the rendering defect with its Error ID. Completed work does not need replay to fix a display registry.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A corrected renderer registry displays existing receipts without rerunning work.

What not to do

  • Do not delete evidence or invent a configuration change for an unexplained internal failure.

Technical notes

  • Output extraction, rendering and summaries do not own execution truth. Their failure cannot turn a completed operation into unexecuted work or justify replay; retained exact receipts remain authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
